pre_grade_drift_check.placeholder_artwork_details: Drift gate clean. compose.py extension for the What's Missing narrative is pending — deck routes to _drafts/ until added (independent of rubric quality).

pedagogical_depth.justification: All five lessons carry expanded_walkthroughs with paired misconceptions and recovery moves. Lesson 1: variable-as-answer. Lesson 2: no-strategy guess. Lesson 3: role-of-variable confusion. Lesson 4: same-numbers-different-order. Lesson 5: no-unknown trap on capstone day.

instructional_balance.justification: CRA progression: balance scale and counters (concrete) → number line and equation cards (representational) → variable equations (abstract). Lesson 5 capstone integrates all three expectations.

clarity_communication.justification: All lessons have substantial teacher_script, 4 expected_student_responses bands, paired misconceptions/recovery. Every lesson has 'I can' student_learning_goal aligned to a specific algebraic skill.

alignment.justification: consistency_check 0 issues; verify_curriculum_text 0 issues; validate_unit_alignment 0 issues. All C2.1-C2.3 codes cited. classroom_time_total_minutes 250 = 5x50.
